Furthermore, according to some interpretations in Islamic tradition, the Prophet Adam and Hawwa are believed to have tasted their first fruit from this tree. Consequently, the name Taymurah, derived from the fig tree, can be seen as a reminder of the Beginning and the enduring significance of prophetic figures and their acts of obedience to the Divine Will.
